question: According to the GSEs' August 2024 PMIERs update (Guidance 2024-01), what is the implementation phase-in schedule, and what substantive change does it make to the PMIERs standards?
expected_answer: The August 21, 2024 PMIERs update refined the Available Assets definition by introducing new investment-risk deductions based on asset class and credit rating (more granular bond credit-quality and liquidity tiers) and establishing new limits on assets backed by residential mortgages or commercial real estate. The phase-in is over 24 months: 25% effective March 31, 2025; 50% effective September 30, 2025; 75% effective March 31, 2026; and 100% effective September 30, 2026. Separately, the COVID-19 Disaster Related Capital Charge for COVID-19 Defaulted Loans was eliminated effective March 31, 2025.
agent_answer:
**PMIERs Guidance 2024-01 — Phase-in Schedule**

| Quarter Ending | Add-back from Prior Framework (i.e., % of old rules still applied) | Implied Phase-in of New Rules |
|---|---|---|
| March 31, 2025 & June 30, 2025 | 75% | 25% |
| September 30, 2025 & December 31, 2025 | 50% | 50% |
| March 31, 2026 & June 30, 2026 | 25% | 75% |
| September 30, 2026 onward | 0% | **100% (fully effective)** |

At the September 30, 2026 milestone, Guidance 2024-01 will be incorporated into the next published version of the PMIERs base text.

**Substantive Changes**

Guidance 2024-01 amends **Section 703 (Available Assets and Minimum Required Assets)** with a set of tighter bond-eligibility rules, haircuts, and concentration limits:

- **Rating requirement**: Bonds must be rated by S&P, Moody's, Fitch, A.M. Best, DBRS, or KBRA; unrated bonds are ineligible.
- **Haircuts by rating**: AAA 0.20%, AA+ to AA- 0.60%, A+ to A- 1.30%, BBB+ to BBB- 2.10%, BB+ to BB- 10.00% (max 5-year term), B+ to B- 25.00% (max 2-year term), CCC+ and below 100%. Full faith and credit U.S. government securities carry a 0% haircut.
- **Exclusions**: Mortgage insurance-linked notes (MILNs); all non-agency residential mortgage-backed securities (RMBS); BB-rated bonds >5 years; B-rated bonds >2 years; all bonds rated CCC+ or below; non-agency CMBS rated below BBB-.
- **Tighter concentration limits**: GSE debt/MBS ≤ 25% of Available Assets; ABS ≤ 20%; sub-investment-grade bonds + common/preferred shares aggregate ≤ 5%; non-agency CMBS ≤ 5%; eligible surplus notes capped at 9% of Minimum Required Assets; COLI ≤ 10% of the risk-based required asset amount.
- **Common/preferred shares discount**: raised from 25% to 50%.
